## CheatReader v0.1.33

### Fixes
- Prevented long paragraphs from repeatedly blocking the reader by bounding text measurements and caching visual line breaks. Wrapping preserves punctuation, Unicode characters, and the complete original text.
- Fixed mouse-wheel events skipping entire wrapped paragraphs when one event advances multiple visual lines. Forward and backward scrolling now wait for layout updates between steps.
- Opening a book from the managed library no longer rewrites its text file. New imports and replacements are written to a temporary file before replacing the destination.
- Import failures now report an error while preserving the active book and reading position, including failures during managed-copy or bookshelf persistence.
- Prevented separate application instances from overwriting unrelated bookshelf entries or resurrecting removed books when saving progress. Bookshelf updates now use per-book operations, cross-process file locking, and atomic file replacement.

### Upgrade notes
- The existing bookshelf and saved reading positions are automatically migrated to the managed library on first launch. No manual re-import is required.
- Application version metadata now matches the release version.

### Verification
- All 87 Flutter tests pass, including text-preservation, multi-step scrolling, storage-failure, migration, and real multi-process persistence regressions.
- `flutter analyze` passes with no issues.
